differences.what: A Medical note type with quick. Its red flags and disposition are the visit's Red flags note, added by itself.
No field carries mapsTo yet. F6-general-assemble adds each mapsTo named below, to the definition and to this piece's shape file, once every target note type exists.
Choose-many: each part picked shows its section.
Chief concern goes into the EMS handoff summary. Expand maps it to general_primary_care:reason.concern.
Choose-one. Yes shows a text box, which Expand maps to general_primary_care:hpi.narrative.

Blood pressure (two numbers), heart rate and temperature, with the units and ranges of the General note's vitals, each in the EMS handoff summary. Expand maps them to general_primary_care:vitals.bp.systolic, vitals.bp.diastolic, vitals.hr and vitals.temp.
Assessment stays a field of the quick form.
Choose-one from the shared list wound_type: Cellulitis and Other are added. Expand maps it to wound_care:wound.type.
differences.why: PRD main 103, 410; inventory A2, A63; forms 6.4

differences.what: A body region from the shared list body_region, with a side of the shared list side (Right, Left, Bilateral, added). Expand maps it to wound_care:wound.location.
Length, width and depth in one row, typed in cm or inches and stored in cm, with the ranges of the Wound care note. Expand maps them to wound_care:wound.measurements.length, .width and .depth.
differences.why: PRD main 404, 411; inventory A29, A59; forms 6.4

differences.what: Choose-one from the shared list drainage_amount. Expand maps it to wound_care:wound.drainage_amount.
Choose-many. The four chips have the shared list dressing's codes, and Other (added) asks for a short text. Expand maps it to wound_care:wound.treatment.dressing.
A photo field, up to 5, a placeholder until phase 8.
